settings.door_hint: Knock, knock — your gift world awaits
settings.hero_intro: A whole little world of presents, wrapped in scent. Step inside and find something unforgettable for everyone on your list.

settings.title: A little world to get lost in
settings.intro:
More than a box of beautiful things, each Ritual in a Box is an invitation to experience one of our scent worlds beyond fragrance. Inside, you'll find a curated collection of POSTCARD essentials, thoughtfully chosen objects, a playlist and a little ritual to bring it all together.

Six different worlds, each with its own way of taking you somewhere else. Made for gifting, discovering and finding a little time for yourself.

settings.title: Hotel Lobby
settings.description:
Bring the feeling of a beautiful hotel stay into your everyday routine. This box pairs our Hotel Lobby fragrance with miniature body wash and shampoo in refillable aluminium bottles, a curated playlist and a simple ritual inspired by the pleasure of checking in somewhere special.

A little luxury, wherever you are.

settings.title: Moon Bloom
settings.description:
An invitation to get cosy and call it a day. Inside, you'll find our soft floral Moon Bloom fragrance, a pair of comfortable crew socks, a bedtime playlist and a gentle ritual to help you wind down.

Thoughtfully put together for the moments when all you want to do is slow down, get comfortable and stay in.

settings.title: Wild Flowers
settings.description:
For those who love taking the scenic route. This box brings together our fresh, floral-herbal Wild Flowers fragrance, a pair of everyday crew socks, a playlist made for wandering and a little ritual that encourages you to step outside and notice the world around you.

A reminder that sometimes the best discoveries happen when you're not looking for anything in particular.

settings.title: Woodland Retreat
settings.description:
A little escape inspired by the calm of the outdoors. Inside, you'll find our refreshing Woodland Retreat fragrance, a miniature body wash, two Lavender Yuzu Hojicha cold brew tea sachets, a feel-good playlist and a ritual that takes you from a refreshing shower to a leisurely walk outside.

Made for clearing your head, finding your pace and enjoying a little breathing room.

settings.title: Bath House
settings.description:
Turn an ordinary shower into a moment to look forward to. Inspired by the quiet warmth of a bath house, this box includes our woody, tea-infused Bath House fragrance, miniature body wash and shampoo in refillable aluminium bottles, a calming playlist and a ritual centred around warm water, slow breaths and letting the day wash away.

A little spa moment, without leaving home.

settings.title: Library Nest
settings.description:
For anyone who loves getting lost in a good book. Inside, you'll find our Library Nest fragrance inspired by the scent of paper, ink and soft woods, a set of magnetic bookmarks, Uji Sencha green tea, a specially curated reading list, a reflective playlist and a ritual made for uninterrupted reading.

Everything you need to settle in, turn a page and forget about the time for a while.

settings.heading: Gifts for every kind of them

settings.title: Gift the whole team.
settings.body: Bespoke festive hampers for hotels, weddings and bossy bosses. From 20 units up.
